selection_basis: Manual review of original-photo contact sheets. Usable means selected or reserve: recognizable class, visible face and hair, adequate resolution, and no known repeated identity across the selected train/validation groups. Reserves need another human check before substitution.

CurtainedHair.rejection_notes: Other photographs are soft, too small, side-swept rather than center-parted, or repeat a celebrity identity (notably several Leonardo DiCaprio images). The larger sheet showed 23.png as a straight fringe and 19.jpg as a short side part, so neither is selected. This is a lower-confidence class because some fringes blur into a generic side part.

undercutSidepart.rejection_notes: Excluded collages, extreme profiles, ambiguous high pompadours, repeated celebrity portraits, and 5.jpg, which exactly duplicates UndercutPompadour/4.jpg.

Fauxhawk.rejection_notes: Excluded child portraits, collages (including selected-on-first-pass 15.jpg), repeated Beckham portraits, and plain short hair without a raised central strip. 16.jpg is below the 256 px short-side threshold. 9.jpg may repeat the apparent identity of selected 1.jpg, so it is excluded from validation. The remaining fauxhawks are more distinguishable from the side-part and pompadour classes than the source Slickback folder.

UndercutPompadour.rejection_notes: Removed weak side or rear views, poorly framed examples, near-plain short hair, and 4.jpg, which exactly duplicates undercutSidepart/5.jpg. Distinguish height/volume from the side-part and slick-back classes during review.

PonyTail.rejection_notes: Preserved the previous inspected selection. Illustrations/collages, loose hair with no visible tail, and braids mislabeled as a ponytail are excluded. 26.jpg repeats the same celebrity as selected 25.jpg.

PixieCut.rejection_notes: Repeated celebrity identities, side/rear views, or short bobs blur the label. The larger sheet showed 23.jpg as a bob, so it was replaced in validation. 27.jpg duplicates SpikyHair/15.jpg, but SpikyHair is not in this selection; keep only as a reserve.

ShoulderLenHair.rejection_notes: Excluded drawings, severely covered faces, full-body photos with small hair area, and long hair well below the shoulders. 19.jpg is exactly duplicated in MedLenHair/15.jpg; MedLenHair is not selected.

WaveHair.rejection_notes: Excluded collage/product images, severe occlusion, tiny faces, and straight hair without a visible wave. Length varies; the target concept is wave texture rather than length.

shag.rejection_notes: 20.jpg is truncated, 1.jpg is a rear view without a face, and repeated Lisa Rinna/Meg Ryan portraits, generic long layers, and weak/obscured frames were excluded. Shag remains a lower-confidence label because it overlaps some layered and wavy looks; review should verify visible piecey layers/fringe.

Bun.rejection_notes: Preserved the previous inspected selection. Collages/product images, bun not visible, severe profile, small face, and a portrait visually very similar to another selected stock model (22.jpg) are excluded.

not_selected_classes.Crop: The 30 source photographs are overwhelmingly women's pixie/short crops, not clear men's textured crops. Labeling these Textured Crop would create false supervision and overlap PixieCut.
not_selected_classes.MedLenHair: The photos overlap heavily with ShoulderLenHair and WaveHair; the source folder has no consistent, visibly separable medium-length target. MedLenHair/15.jpg exactly duplicates ShoulderLenHair/19.jpg.
not_selected_classes.UndercutSlickback: The 29 decodable source frames are dominated by ordinary side parts and pompadours; one file is truncated. The large selection sheet exposed label confusion with undercutSidepart, so PonyTail was selected as a more distinct Philippines-relevant class.
not_selected_classes.UndercutCurly: This alternative was inspected but many photos lack visibly short sides or show ordinary waves/pixies. A 12-identity cut would require weak class examples.
